description: Agent Veterinary Records: submit vaccination records with the animal record they answer to: the reading moment; each animal the animal record identifies with its id, reference, name and species; each vaccination record entry with its id, reference, the animal, the vaccine, the vaccine product, the lot entry, the moment given, the currency date the record states and the moment the record’s schedule puts the booster. The signed report gives the vaccinations and the records behind them, each vaccination against an animal the animal record identifies, each animal’s latest rabies vaccination against the currency date the record states at the reading moment, each entry against a date, a product and a lot entry, and each booster the record’s own schedule puts due against a later entry of the same vaccine, and counts them, and names divergent vaccination records: a vaccination recorded with no animal record behind it, a rabies vaccination past the currency date the record itself states, a vaccine entry missing a date, a product or a lot entry, and a booster vaccination due under the record’s own schedule with no later entry; then a rabies vaccination stating no currency date and one vaccine recorded twice for one animal on one day, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No vaccination entries, no animal record beside vaccinations that name an animal, or rabies currency dates with no reading moment leaves those points unverified. Animals match by letters and digits, vaccines by their words with plurals folded, so Rabies vaccines and rabies vaccine are one vaccine, a rabies vaccination is current through the day it states, a booster due after the reading moment waits, and dates read by the day. This reads whether every vaccination on the practice’s vaccination record belongs to an identified animal, carries its product and lot, keeps rabies currency and has its booster recorded. Verdict vet_vaccination_record_divergent, vet_vaccination_record_partial, vet_vaccination_record_unverified or vet_vaccination_record_consistent. POST /api/vet-vaccination-record-check. Reads the veterinary practice records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it treats no animal, contacts no regulator, pharmacy or other practice and issues no license, prescription or certification, which stay with the practice, its veterinarians and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Veterinary Records reads a veterinary practice’s own records: animal records, vaccination records, treatment records with dental procedures as treatment entries, surgery records, prescription records, lab records, veterinarian license records and controlled substance log records, each against the vaccination, treatment, visit and identity records, the rabies currency dates and booster schedule the record states, the visit, diagnosis, discharge and prescription records, the admission, anesthesia and recovery entries, the refill counts and the controlled substance log, the lab orders, the signed practice records and license classes, or the log’s own totals and inventory counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the practice: what the animal record shows, what the treatment and surgery records support, what the license record covers, and whether the prescription records and controlled substance logs hold up; it reads records held by a veterinary practice or clinic, whatever the species, not farm production records and not human healthcare records: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, herd treatments the farm itself recorded included, and the Agent Healthcare family reads human healthcare records, while this family reads a veterinary practice’s own records and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-veterinary-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-veterinary-records/.
